build_obs_preprocessor: build an ObsPreprocessor instance with a DictConfig and torch device for ImageNav observation preprocessing
reset_obs_preprocessor: reset the ObsPreprocessor episode state to clear goal image, keypoints, mask, and step counter
preprocess_observations: preprocess Observations to return RGB-depth-keypoint tensor, pose delta, camera pose, matches, and confidence
review_preprocess_frame: review the _preprocess_frame method that downscales RGB/depth and computes keypoint localization via SuperGlue matching
summarize_preprocess_pose_and_delta: summarize the _preprocess_pose_and_delta method that merges GPS and compass data to compute relative pose change
